anomalies.description: A man in the driver's seat of a red car is seen holding and aiming a handgun out the driver-side window, with his arm extended and finger on the trigger guard; the weapon is clearly visible and oriented forward.

The rear tire of the red car rapidly deflates and collapses onto the ground, indicating a sudden puncture or blowout, consistent with being shot; the tire visibly loses pressure and flattens over frames f12–f15.

Armed individuals are actively aiming and firing weapons; frame f0 shows a man with an assault rifle aimed, f2 shows a man shouting while holding a pistol, and f3 shows another man aiming a scoped rifle.

A man in a green cap and tactical vest is seen aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is visible in frame f10 (37.0s), confirming discharge.; A second individual wearing a beanie and sunglasses aims a rifle with a scope; the weapon is held in a firing stance, consistent with active engagement.; Multiple armed individuals surround a red car; at least two are holding firearms pointed toward the vehicle or its occupants, indicating an ongoing armed confrontation with potential gunfire (though no muzzle flash visible in these frames).

Multiple armed men are pointing firearms at individuals near a car; frames f4–f6 show two men aiming pistols, f7 shows a man aiming a pistol, and f8 shows a woman observing the standoff; f9 shows a man firing a pistol (muzzle flash implied by posture and context).; Man in green cap aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash and recoil visible.; Bearded man in turban holds a handgun, pointing it forward; posture suggests active engagement or imminent firing.

A large explosion occurs in a military-style compound, producing a massive fireball, smoke plume, and debris; visible in f11 (initial blast), f12 (expanding smoke), and aerial views f13–f15 showing widespread destruction and lingering smoke.
Large-scale explosion at a military-style compound: initial blast at 41.5s (f3) with debris and smoke, followed by expanding fireball and rising smoke plume through aerial shots (f4–f15).
